The genus demarcation boundary is set by the highest AF and ANI values of a type species (i.e., other than the primary reference) in an order/family.

Whereas the genus demarcation boundary is a hard boundary, the genus inflection point represents a soft boundary that highlights a region where the rate of change is starting to decrease at the genome level.
